reasons: The cited language in § 6 is a Vendor-granted MFN ('rates charged for Hosting Services will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party'), which runs in Customer's favour and is expressly welcomed by the rule.

No obligation on Client to extend TrueLink terms no less favourable than those given to third parties or to match third-party offers appears in the quoted paragraphs; § 5(a) is an ordinary fee/invoicing provision.
Consistent with the compliant status and redline guidance ('keep any Vendor-granted MFN'), the proposal leaves the text unchanged and adds no counterparty comment, which is the expected output.
